title: 1.2 People in Action
unit_outcome: Understand and say short German sentences about people and what they are doing.
goal: Use der, die, and das with each person, then say what one person is doing with one German verb.
prerequisite: German 1.1: ein, eine, the four people, er, sie, and ist.
speaking_outcome: Say what one person is doing.

cards.pedagogy_note: der: the boy gets his article.
isst: German has one verb where English says is eating.
Der Junge + isst.
der again: der Mann.
trinkt: he is drinking.

cards.spanish_translation: The man is drinking. He is drinking.
cards.pedagogy_note: Noun sentence, then pronoun sentence.
liest: she is reading.

cards.spanish_translation: The girl is reading. She is reading.
cards.pedagogy_note: das: Mädchen takes das.
schreibt: she is writing.

cards.spanish_translation: The woman is writing. She is writing.
cards.pedagogy_note: die: Frau takes die. All three articles are now met.
